# Voiqu Growth Consulting

> Voiqu is the growth consulting practice of Horațiu Voicu, helping B2B SaaS and E-commerce brands scale using Data, AI, and Automation, with a focus on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI search visibility.

## About Horațiu Voicu
- Working in SEO since 2012; Google Partner from 2014 to 2026.
- Builds AI search visibility tooling at Genezio (https://genezio.com), including GEO monitoring of how brands are cited and recommended by LLMs.
- Implements advanced tracking with Google Tag Manager, Conversions API and Enhanced Conversions, and builds reporting in Looker Studio.
- Previously: founding team member at ANSWEAR Romania, SEO Director at MTH.Digital, Head of Digital at Perceptum.ro.
- Profile: https://voiqu.com/about · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/voiqu/

## Services
- **Data Audit**: Deep dive into analytics and customer journeys.
- **Strategy**: Defining KPIs and architecting automation.
- **System Implementation**: Implementation of campaigns and integrations.
- **Analysis & Iteration**: Continuous optimization of ROAS and LTV.
